title: 13 Squid Bering Tropical Pineapple Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bering from 13 Squid is an exquisite Pineapple vape loaded with tropical flavour. The fruit’s fresh, succulent tanginess is complemented to perfection with a wave of icy menthol that both soothes and wakens the senses on the exhale, producing an incredibly moreish all-day vape. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
